description: Source file implementing classes and methods related to plugin services, request handling, file serving, and network configuration within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: PluginHost::Request
classes.description: Handles web requests, manages request state, and associates with a service.

classes.name: PluginHost::Service
classes.description: Provides notification and file serving functionalities, and handles web server requests.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: Represents a shell job with a static create method.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Contains network configuration utilities, such as obtaining IPv4 unicast node IDs.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request to its initial state.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Set
methods.description: Sets the request state based on error code, service, and type.

methods.name: IShell::Job::Create
methods.description: Creates a new shell job instance.

methods.name: Service::Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to all registered notifiers.

methods.name: Service::FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over web request, handling MIME types and encoding.

methods.name: Service::IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Checks if a segment matches the web server request prefix.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 unicast node ID for a given interface name.
